facts.text: Caroline expressed gratitude for the support of friends, family, and mentors, which inspires her to continue creating art.

evidence.quote: I'm really thankful for my friends, family and mentors' support. It inspires me to keep making art, too.

facts.text: Caroline has been creating art since she was 17 years old, finding it empowering and cathartic.

evidence.quote: Since I was 17 or so. I find it so empowering and cathartic.

facts.text: Melanie has been involved in art for seven years and has found her muses in painting and pottery.

evidence.quote: Seven years now, and I've finally found my real muses: painting and pottery.

facts.text: Caroline mentioned that painting and drawing have helped her express her feelings and explore her gender identity, particularly during her transition.

evidence.quote: Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself.
